name: quark-torch-quant-perf
description: Run, resume, monitor, diagnose, and report Quark Quant-Perf workflows for PyTorch and HuggingFace transformers models. Use whenever the user asks for mixed-precision search, Quark MXFP4/FP8/PTPC-FP8 quantization with accuracy and performance validation, vLLM throughput, TraceLens bottleneck analysis, GEAK kernel optimization, PerfOpt retries, workspace source discovery, or a natural-language request that must become a quark-quant-perf command. Not for ONNX models.
